title: Ankhorage Neon Infrastructure
summary: Records the repository boundary reserved for Neon-hosted PostgreSQL infrastructure.
purpose: Keep ownership of future Neon infrastructure distinct from database application code and provider-neutral database contracts.
responsibilities: Own the repository-level boundary for Neon infrastructure artifacts when they are introduced.
boundaries: Does not currently contain deployable Neon configuration or automation.
Does not own provider-neutral database contracts or application persistence behavior.
audience: Infrastructure maintainers evaluating or introducing Neon-hosted PostgreSQL resources.

architecture.role: Non-source infrastructure repository with no deployed implementation on the current default branch.
invariants: Any future provider configuration remains separate from application and database-contract ownership.

limitations: The current default branch contains licensing and repository metadata only; it does not provision Neon resources.
